name: Nobu Las Vegas at Caesars Palace

address.street: 3570 Las Vegas Blvd S Las Vegas

insider_take: Where Japanese culinary artistry meets Vegas glamour in the heart of Caesars Palace.
whats_special: This is the first and only Nobu hotel on the Las Vegas Strip, featuring celebrity chef Nobu Matsuhisa's signature style throughout 181 ultra-modern suites. The property seamlessly blends minimalist Japanese design with Vegas luxury, offering exclusive access to the world-renowned Nobu Restaurant and sake bar downstairs.
pro_tip: Book dinner at Nobu Restaurant before arrival - it's consistently rated as one of Vegas's most difficult reservations to secure, but hotel guests get priority booking privileges.
dont_miss: The signature black cod miso at Nobu Restaurant, panoramic Strip views from corner suites, and the exclusive Nobu sake collection featuring rare bottles you won't find anywhere else in Nevada. The hotel's location within Caesars Palace also grants you access to the Forum Shops and the Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis.
pros: World-renowned Nobu culinary experience and Japanese-inspired design
Prime location within iconic Caesars Palace complex
Luxury boutique hotel with intimate, sophisticated atmosphere
Access to Caesars Palace amenities and entertainment
cons: Smaller boutique property with limited on-site facilities
